summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Allarity Therapeutics reporting the intended use of a corporate presentation in investor meetings (Item 7.01 Regulation FD) and the CEO's invitation to speak at a conference (Item 8.01 Other Events). No special situation—such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change—is described. The filing merely discloses standard investor communications and a speaking engagement, with no deal terms, material corporate transactions, or strategic actions. Accordingly, this filing does not qualify as any special-situations category.
